purpose: Bind by content hash the 24 hypothesis, experiment-contract and handoff artifacts produced for the eleven IDEA-20260806-* proposals, so independent review reads a fixed object.

lifecycle_compliance.why_not: The 24 declared artifacts were already committed and merged to main in pull request #202 (branch commits f03f25403 and 0d252527a) before this receipt existed. A snapshot is defined by AGENTS.md as the commit that introduces the producer artifacts BEFORE review. No commit made now can be that commit.
lifecycle_compliance.what_this_receipt_does_instead: Records the sha256 of each declared artifact as merged. Under the content-first rule in CLAUDE.md -- archive receipts bind to CONTENT first and commit reachability is advisory -- the hash map is the load-bearing part and remains valid.
lifecycle_compliance.commit_sha_is_null_because: The receipt is committed inside the commit it describes; a file cannot contain the hash of the commit containing it. Committing a receipt in a separate commit is the defect recorded in CORR-20260802-009 and is not repeated.
lifecycle_compliance.receipt_self_hash_omitted_because: A file cannot contain its own final digest. Same convention as TASK-20260802-f92a96's snapshot-receipt.json.

introducing_commits.f03f25403: drafted H-RHO-bc6ea6/EXP-RHO-60da4f and H-REPL-6c431d/EXP-REPL-1d1287 at review_required
introducing_commits.0d252527a: approved the two contracts, added their executor handoffs, drafted the nine further contracts
introducing_commits.note: Both reached main via the merge of pull request #202. Reachability is advisory; content is authoritative.

approval_state_at_binding.consequence: No run record depends on the previously unresolvable archived_by pointer, so nothing downstream requires superseding.

path_sha256_note: 24 artifacts. The receipt's own path is deliberately absent: its digest is its content before this map was filled, and the dispatcher verifies content.
